{{Quote|Can someone please frag the node that little punk is posting off, so we can discuss this thing with quiet?''"<br />"''Done.|h8thegam and daddy, regarding disabling the access of wampa1 to the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>}}
The handle '''h8thegam''' was the user ID of an individual active on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The user contributed to a discussion on a Cularin holonet node forum regarding an intercepted message distributed by the user [[mstrslcr]] which some interpreted as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] report recommending intervention in the operation of the [[Almas Academy|Jedi academy]] on the<ref name="academic review" /> [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Almas]]. Following some incendiary posts on the thread by the user [[wampa1]], h8thegam requested that someone disable the holonet node via which wampa1 was accessing the forum; the user [[daddy]] claimed subsequently to have done so.<ref name="academic review" />
